label: Four Futures foundation
description: A low-friction research path: frame one inquiry, confirm keywords, compare four What-if futures, choose one branch, then discuss it in a focused scope.

stages.label: Frame the inquiry
stages.description: Capture the topic, point of view, research concern, assumptions, stakeholders, and tension as one editable research brief.

stages.label: Confirm keywords
stages.description: Keep a deterministic keyword scaffold beside the brief; a later keyword operation can replace it without changing the workflow.

stages.label: Generate four What-if futures
stages.description: Run the existing Guided Scenario operation from direct research inputs only.

stages.label: Choose one future
stages.description: Compare all four branches before explicitly selecting one; no branch is selected automatically.

stages.label: Discuss the chosen future
stages.description: Move the existing conversation session into the selected branch Scope, attach one empty discussion-tool node, and require one selected method before a later scenario or materialisation run.
